svg.aria-label: Dots in a strip of the s-plane. Column N sits at real part 1 over 2N and holds the zeta zeros divided by N. The columns crowd onto the imaginary axis, drawn in pink as the wall.
svg.text: The singular points ρ/N pile onto the line Re s = 0
column N sits at Re s = 1/(2N) →
Column N holds the zeros of ζ(Ns): ζ's zeros, squashed by N toward 0. Shown up to N = 12;
as N grows the columns keep closing in, and they fill the line Re s = 0 with no gaps.
